fib: ______ are the most valuable asset required in the implementation of any GIS programme.
Personnel
Personnel are the most valuable asset required in the implementation of any GIS programme.
______ are the physical electronic devices used in performing GIS operations.
hardware components of GIS
The hardware components of GIS are the physical electronic devices used in performing GIS operations.

______ is a computer based information system used to digitally represent and analyse the geographic features and events on the Earth' surface and the non-spatial attributes linked to the geography under study.
Modern geographic information system

Modern geographic information system is a computer based information system used to digitally represent and analyse the geographic features and events on the Earth' surface and the non-spatial attributes linked to the geography under study.
______ is one of the five major components of GIS.
Method or procedure
Method or procedure is one of the five major components of GIS.
______ are used to help with address matching when the spellings of addresses differ.
Various algorithms
Various algorithms are used to help with address matching when the spellings of addresses differ.
______ are those involved in the provision of the hardware and software, acquisition and handling of data, as well as decision making and implementation.
GIS personnel
GIS personnel are those involved in the provision of the hardware and software, acquisition and handling of data, as well as decision making and implementation.
______ are used for linear features such as rivers, roads, railroads, trails, and topographic lines.
One-dimensional lines or polylines
One-dimensional lines or polylines are used for linear features such as rivers, roads, railroads, trails, and topographic lines.
______ are used for geographical features that cover a particular area of the earth's surface.
Two-dimensional polygons
Two-dimensional polygons are used for geographical features that cover a particular area of the earth's surface.
______ is one of the major functions a GIS performs.
Spatial analysis
Spatial analysis is one of the major functions a GIS performs.
______ is a critical aspect of GIS operations.
Data input
Data input is a critical aspect of GIS operations.
______ is a software package with a collection of computer programs that controls the creation, organisation, maintenance, selection and the use of data in a database.
DBMS
A DBMS is a software package with a collection of computer programs that controls the creation, organisation, maintenance, selection and the use of data in a database.
______ are the spherical (geographic) coordinate system and the rectangular coordinate system.
Examples of coordinate systems
Examples of coordinate systems are the spherical (geographic) coordinate system and the rectangular coordinate system.
______ is a special type of database query supported by geodatabases and spatial databases.
spatial query
A spatial query is a special type of database query supported by geodatabases and spatial databases.
______ is a theory of how a database is supposed to look like.
database model
A database model is a theory of how a database is supposed to look like.
______ is a type of database that is in some way referenced to locations on the earth.
geodatabase
A geodatabase is a type of database that is in some way referenced to locations on the earth.
______ are used to graphically represent some real world features.
Spatial data
Spatial data are used to graphically represent some real world features.
______ is a flat electronic board used for vectorisation of a given map objects.
digitiser
A digitiser is a flat electronic board used for vectorisation of a given map objects.
______ are used to obtain the hardcopy versions of processed data.
Output devices
Output devices are used to obtain the hardcopy versions of processed data.
______ is the raw material that GIS processes to yield a highly sort after product namely, information.
Data
Data is the raw material that GIS processes to yield a highly sort after product namely, information.
______ is the technical process of entering or putting information into the computer system.
Data capture or conversion
Data capture or conversion is the technical process of entering or putting information into the computer system.
______ is a form of data output - softcopy output.
Data display
Data display is a form of data output - softcopy output.
